svg.title: Blue Blade Eyes — Edge of Sapphire. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ice classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Sapphire Edge forks into Honed Crescent then Stroke That Splits Stone, or Frostbitten Grip then Numb to the Marrow. Unblinking Sapphire forks into Hoarfrost Bulwark then Glacier Does Not Yield, or Thirst of the Frost then Winter Takes Its Due. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu.

Sapphire Edge answers \"How do I win the trade of blows: sharpen mine or dull theirs?\": Burst takes the four self damage buffs to 40% on Honed Crescent and pays off with a controlled +2 Damage on Stroke That Splits Stone (40 \u2192 42 and 45 \u2192 47 EP, no tier change), and Suppression (Numb to the Marrow) takes Icebound Might's circle to 40% Decrease Damage Given with a light guard rider. Unblinking Sapphire answers \"How do I outlast them: refuse their blows, or drink them dry?\": Fortress (Glacier Does Not Yield) takes both guard rows to 45%, and Drain (Winter Takes Its Due) takes Arctic Frost's Lifesteal to the 45% ceiling with exposure at 40%. Shield, stun, buffprevent, wound, move and redirection are unsupported and untouched. Due"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Structure kept from Draft 4 (01\u219202\u219203, 01\u219204\u219205, 06\u219207\u219208, 06\u219209\u219210). Each Foundation pairs a self buff with an enemy debuff and its children lean to opposite sides: Sapphire Edge (Increase Damage Given + Decrease Damage Given) forks into Burst (Honed Crescent \u2192 Stroke That Splits Stone) and Suppression (Frostbitten Grip \u2192 Numb to the Marrow); Unblinking Sapphire (Increase Damage Taken + Decrease Damage Taken) forks into Fortress (Hoarfrost Bulwark \u2192 Glacier Does Not Yield) and Drain (Thirst of the Frost \u2192 Winter Takes Its Due). Lifesteal stands in for Afterburn (no Afterburn rows).","Damage: Draft 4's +5 route (Honed Crescent +2, Stroke That Splits Stone +3) lifted every Damage row in the kit a tier: Icebound Might, Glacial Volley and Blue Crimson 40 \u2192 45, Ice Shackles and Blade Resonance 45 \u2192 50 (High to Nuke). Burst now sets up on Honed Crescent (+3% Increase Damage Given) and pays a single +2 Damage on Stroke That Splits Stone: 40 \u2192 42 and 45 \u2192 47 EP, no tier change, and +2 is the maximum over every legal allocation.","Leverage: Increase Damage Given (four self rows) and Increase Damage Taken (three enemy rows; every attacker on the target benefits) compound per hit with one another and with the 28.75% passive, so both stop at +5%: three rows up at once give \u00d71.40\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.74 against \u00d72.46 at base (+11%). Draft 4's +3% Increase Damage Given rider on Numb to the Marrow (Suppression out-amplified Burst) and +3% exposure rider on Glacier Does Not Yield (both Unblinking Sapphire capstones leaned on exposure) are removed, and Winter Takes Its Due's exposure rider falls from +5% to +3% so Lifesteal stays the Drain identity (Increase Damage Taken maximum +7% \u2192 +5%).","Narrow coverage: Decrease Damage Given (Icebound Might) and Lifesteal (Arctic Frost) each reach one row, so those capstones carry a light identity-compatible rider (guard +2% Decrease Damage Taken, below Hoarfrost Bulwark's +3%; exposure +3% Increase Damage Taken) instead of a larger primary. The Damage (five rows) and Decrease Damage Taken (two rows) capstones carry their primary alone.","Castability: six of eight jutsu need one of two HAND-slot bloodline weapons (The Threefold Gaze: Icebound Might, Glacial Volley, Ice Shackles; The Blue Blade: Blade Resonance, Blue Crimson, Arctic Frost); no node lists an item and no bonus is limited by one. Castable rows: Threefold Gaze = Damage 3, IDG 2, DDG 1, IDT 1, DDT 2; Blue Blade = Damage 2, IDG 3, IDT 3, DDT 2, Lifesteal 1; no weapon = IDG 1, IDT 1, DDT 2. Dual wielding was not read at the pin.","Resolver and delivery: nine of eleven buff/debuff rows have a stat filter but no element, so getEfficiencyRatio (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73) matches them to Ice hits, normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks alike; Blade Resonance's exposure and Arctic Frost's damage buff carry Earth/Ice/None/Water/Wind. Cooldown 7 on every jutsu; damage casts cost 60 AP, the rest 40 AP; percentage rows live the 2 rounds after the cast (\u00a73b), so Glacial Volley's and Blue Crimson's own buff never boosts their own hit. Quintessential Flake's guard and damage buff are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast, not through the tile (actions.ts 980-1004).","Fourth purchases: Burst adds Unblinking Sapphire or Frostbitten Grip; Suppression adds Unblinking Sapphire or Honed Crescent; Fortress adds Sapphire Edge or Thirst of the Frost; Drain adds Hoarfrost Bulwark or Sapphire Edge. No capstone shares a tag with its sibling Hidden Art, so no fourth purchase stacks a capstone's own tag; the strongest cross-route fourth, Honed Crescent under Suppression, trades Stroke That Splits Stone's +2 Damage for Numb to the Marrow's suppression and guard."],"risks":["Classification: Ice is shared with Hyouga Yui, Teno Yuki and other census bloodlines (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 7 of 16 kit rows carry Ice; the other nine need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Quintessential Flake and Sapphire Command (no Ice row) additionally need an authored Ice jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Ice coverage is unverified.","Castability: 12 of 16 supported rows sit on weapon-gated jutsu. Burst's Damage rows are split across both weapons (three on The Threefold Gaze, two on The Blue Blade); Suppression's row is cast with The Threefold Gaze and Drain's with The Blue Blade; only the Fortress's primary rows need no weapon. Gates decide castability, not eligibility.","Ally hazard: Icebound Might row 0 (Damage, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, friendly fire none = ALL) hits allies in the circle, never the caster; Stroke That Splits Stone raises that to 42 EP for allies inside. Sapphire Command's exposure row (friendly fire none, single target) exposes an ally at 37\u201340% if cast on one.","Multiplier stacking: four self damage buffs reach 40% each at the maximum and all stack (process.ts 1109-1117): three timed to share a round give \u00d71.40\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.74 (\u00d72.46 at base), all four (both weapons) \u00d71.40\u2074 \u2248 \u00d73.84, and the 28.75% passive then multiplies. The three exposure rows reach the same 40% under Drain and multiply with them. Rotation and uptime were not simulated.","Lifesteal: Arctic Frost's leech reaches 45% of every hit landed in its two-round window (no element: Ice hits, normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks qualify; pierce included). It shares the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage budget with vamp; needs both combatants alive; healprevent on the caster blocks it.","Suppression and guard: Decrease Damage Given is one AOE row on a 60 AP cast (40% at maximum; value scales with enemies inside). Decrease Damage Taken is two SELF rows on 40 AP casts; with both up matching non-pierce hits take \u00d70.55 \u00d7 0.55 \u2248 \u00d70.30 at the Fortress maximum (\u00d70.42 at base; damage never falls below 10% of the boosted, system-reduced hit). Not simulated.","No adverse rows, hidden rows, mode restrictions or injected children exist; the unsupported rows are unchanged and pierce is absent. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked modes. Rank context: S-rank with a 28.75% Increase Damage Given passive at jutsu level 25 and a 100 regen bonus; cross-bloodline comparison is deferred to the roster review."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":5},"supported_rows_in_kit":16,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":5,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"increasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":3,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ice classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Stroke That Splits Stone path + Unblinking Sapphire
Numb to the Marrow path + Unblinking Sapphire
Glacier Does Not Yield path + Sapphire Edge
Winter Takes Its Due path + Hoarfrost Bulwark
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE BLUE BLADE EYES KIT
